560	He was versed in the Account of Creation, meaning everything about the teachings of the world of Tikkun before the Tikkun.	Dominava a Obra da Criação, isto é, tudo sobre os ensinamentos do mundo do Tikkun antes do Tikkun.
561	In the Account of the Chariot, the teachings after the Tikkun.	Na Obra da Carruagem, os ensinamentos de depois do Tikkun.
562	He was versed in the speech of trees, knowing what one tree says to another. Open Yehuda, Sukkah	Dominava a conversa das árvores: sabia o que uma árvore diz à outra. Abram o Yehuda, Sucá
563	28a, on Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai, who was versed in the conversation of palm trees. Writes	28a, sobre Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai, que dominava a conversa das palmeiras. Escreve
564	Rav Hai Gaon: sometimes there is wind, and one palm turns to its fellow and sweetens a secret for it.	Rav Hai Gaon: às vezes há vento, e uma palmeira se volta para a companheira e lhe sussurra um segredo.
565	Now, Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai knew what secret was revealed to him, and Rabbeinu	Ora, Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai sabia que segredo lhe foi revelado, e Rabeinu	
566	HaAri also knew what the trees say. Rav Hai Gaon was versed in knowing the future by	HaAri também sabia o que as árvores dizem. Rav Hai Gaon sabia conhecer o futuro pelo	
567	the movement of the leaves in the wind. See what secrets have gone from us.	movimento das folhas ao vento. Vejam que segredos se foram de nós.
568	He was versed in the speech of birds.	Dominava a conversa das aves.
569	What is the speech of birds?	O que é a conversa das aves?
570	The Zohar writes that the raven, how it flies, how it moves, how it calls "kra, kra,"	O Zohar escreve que o corvo, como voa, como se move, como grita "crá, crá",
571	all are hints and supernal secrets, and Rabbeinu HaAri was versed in this.	tudo são indícios e segredos superiores, e Rabeinu HaAri dominava isso.
572	In the speech of angels, that is, the seven angels.	Na conversa dos anjos, isto é, os sete anjos.
573	He knew the wisdom of the face.	Conhecia a sabedoria da fisionomia.
574	The Zohar writes there: one with large ears, one with sunken eyes, one with thick eyebrows, one	O Zohar escreve ali: quem tem orelhas grandes, quem tem olhos fundos, quem tem sobrancelhas grossas, quem
575	with smooth hair, one with curly hair, one with a thick beard.	tem cabelo liso, quem tem cabelo crespo, quem tem barba espessa.
576	Each thing hints at something else about a person.	Cada coisa indica algo diferente sobre a pessoa.
577	All this is in the Zohar. Open the Zohar.	Tudo isso está no Zohar. Abram o Zohar.
578	Zohar, Tikunim, page 121b; Zohar Chadash, page 39b onward; and also in Zohar Yitro,	Zohar, Tikunim, página 121b; Zohar Chadash, página 39b em diante; e também no Zohar Yitro,
579	"Ata Techeze," page 73a onward.	"Atá Techezê", página 73a em diante.
580	And the whole Zohar there speaks of the merit of the wisdom of the face, astonishing things.	E todo o Zohar ali fala do mérito da sabedoria da fisionomia, coisas assombrosas.
581	Rabbeinu HaAri knew all the deeds of people, what they did and what they would do. He spoke with the winds,	Rabeinu HaAri conhecia todos os atos das pessoas, o que fizeram e o que ainda fariam. Falava com os ventos,
582	he spoke with the birds, he would bring a person's soul while he was still alive.	falava com as aves, trazia a alma da pessoa ainda em vida.
583	He would speak with him and say, "Why are you lying?"	Falava com ele e dizia: "Por que você mente?"
584	He would say to him, "But I am not lying, Rabbi."	Ele respondia: "Mas eu não minto, Rabino."
585	He said to him, "Not lying?"	Dizia-lhe: "Não mente?"
586	He would draw out his soul, speak with the soul, and say, "The soul is standing beside you and says	Tirava-lhe a alma, falava com a alma e dizia: "A alma está ao seu lado e diz	
587	that yesterday you did such and such."	que ontem você fez isso e aquilo."
588	"How dare you be insolent?"	"Como ousa ser insolente?"
589	He would speak with him.	Falava com ele.
590	And he would return the soul inside him. He saw souls as they left the body. He would go to the	E devolvia-lhe a alma ao corpo. Via as almas ao saírem do corpo. Ia aos	
591	cemeteries and see all the souls sitting on the graves, and we checked after him once, twice,	cemitérios e via todas as almas sentadas sobre os túmulos, e o verificamos uma, duas	
592	and three times: astonishing things not seen since the days of Rashbi. He spoke with the souls of the tzaddikim in the World to Come,	e três vezes: coisas assombrosas que não se viam desde os dias de Rashbi. Falava com as almas dos tsadikim no Mundo Vindouro,	
593	and they revealed to him the secrets of the Torah. He would go to sleep at night, his soul would ascend, and the Prince of the Face would ask	e eles lhe revelavam os segredos da Torá. Ia dormir à noite, sua alma subia, e o príncipe da face lhe perguntava	
594	him, "Which yeshiva do you want to go up to?" One day he would go to the yeshiva of Moshe Rabeinu, one day	"A que yeshivá você quer subir?" Um dia ia à yeshivá de Moshe Rabeinu, outro dia	
595	to the yeshiva of Rabbi Akiva, one day another, and he would come down in the morning remembering all he had learned.	à de Rabi Akiva, outro dia a outra, e descia de manhã lembrando tudo o que aprendera.
596	He knew the interpretation of dreams from their beds; he knew how many errors had crept into books.	Sabia interpretar sonhos pelo leito deles; sabia quantos erros se haviam infiltrado nos livros.
597	He would look at a book: "You have 15 errors here."	Olhava um livro: "Você tem 15 erros aqui."
598	That is how he knew.	Assim ele sabia.
599	How many errors had crept into books.	Quantos erros se haviam infiltrado nos livros.
